source_findings: The native validation harness uses the real spectralDNS context and explicitly sets c.Source.fill(0).

The adapter scans the exact current u_hat support on every sparse call and falls back permanently to the original dense callback when the support is outside the retained domain or exceeds sparse_limit.
The adapter preserves the unprojected nonlinear term; pressure projection and diffusion remain in upstream ComputeRHS after the convection callback.

Pinned upstream ComputeRHS adds Source only after convection, Nyquist masking, pressure projection and diffusion. The published host matrix therefore certifies only the zero-Source case; nonzero or time-dependent Source was not independently exercised here.
The validation harness uses one timestep dt=0.002 for 12 steps. It does not perform a timestep-refinement study.

The harness checks initial zero-plane Hermitian symmetry and one-RHS projected divergence, but does not expose an explicit all-step conjugacy certificate or a general energy-behavior series; the analytic shear decay check is narrower.

local_execution_capability.consequence: No honest native-host rerun was possible in this execution environment.
